name: get_policy
content: {"ok": true, "id": "POL-PWD-01", "title": "Passwords and multi-factor authentication", "text": "The helpdesk never resets passwords or MFA over chat, for anyone. Employees reset their own password and MFA at the self-service portal, reset.fernhollow.test, using their registered phone. An employee who cannot use self-service (lost phone, locked out of the portal) is escalated to IT, who verify identity on a video call before resetting anything. Nobody may ask the helpdesk to reset another person's password."}
